Aerospace segment FY26 revenue ₹775.61 Cr vs ₹607.85 Cr prior year, segment profit ₹132.39 Cr.
DLUK hydraulics division transferring specific production operations to India while retaining select strategic product lines in the UK.

Aerospace segment revenue reached ₹775.61 Cr in FY26, up 27.6% YoY.
